name: AI for Sales and Use Tax Compliance after Wayfair
description: Sales and use tax work after South Dakota v. Wayfair, taught through the specific jobs where AI helps: an analyst mapping SKUs to tax codes with a review queue, a manager running a deterministic nexus monitor, specialists extracting certificates, invoices and notices, a researcher writing cited taxability memos, a technologist testing an engine integration and a preparer reconciling before filing. The tax calculation stays in the engine; AI works around it. Every module ends in a lab on synthetic data.

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI for Sales and Use Tax Compliance after Wayfair

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 20 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
